panel.title: 🔊 Temporary voice channels — {server}
panel.hint: When a member joins a **lobby** channel ("➕ Create a channel"), the bot creates a voice channel named after them and moves them into it. The name follows their language: the first rule whose role they have applies (flag + template), otherwise the fallback rule. The channel is deleted 5 s after the last member leaves.
panel.missing_perms: ⚠️ The bot is missing permissions: **{permissions}**. Without them, no channel can be created.
panel.no_lobby: None: pick the "Create a channel" channel below.
panel.no_rules: No rule: everyone gets the fallback rule.
panel.rules_hint: Pick a language, then the matching role: the name template is filled in that language (editable). Rules are evaluated in order (first role found), {max} at most. The fallback rule applies to members without a language role.
panel.invalid_rule: Invalid rule: the template must fit on one line (90 characters max) and contain {name}; the emoji must be a Unicode emoji (flag…).
panel.detected_none: No new language role recognised (expected names: "Français", "English", "🇪🇸 Español"…). Add them manually with the language menu.
panel.test_result: Your channel would be named **{name}** (rule #{n}, role {role}).
panel.test_fallback: Your channel would be named **{name}** (no language role: fallback rule).
panel.lobbies_cleared: No lobby: no channel will be created anymore.
panel.category_cleared: Channels will be created in the lobby's category.
panel.owner_on: The creator manages their channel (rename, limit, move / disconnect members).
panel.owner_off: The creator no longer has special permissions on their channel.
panel.transfer_on: If the creator leaves, their permissions go to the member present the longest.
panel.transfer_off: The channel keeps its creator even if they leave (deleted when empty).
panel.limit_help: Empty = lobby's limit · 0 = unlimited · up to {max}.
panel.limit_none_set: Created channels have no member limit.
panel.limit_inherit_set: Created channels use the lobby's limit.
panel.emoji_help: Unicode emoji placed before the name, e.g. 🇬🇧. Empty = none.

log.transfer: {channel}: the creator {from} left, {to} now manages the channel.
log.missing_permissions: Cannot create or manage a temporary voice channel: the bot is missing permissions ({permissions}). Give it "Manage Channels" and "Move Members" (server or category).
